races.title: State House, District 47
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: John L. Lowery
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House for District 47, appointed in October 2025 after Jarrod Lowery resigned. Chairman of the Lumbee Tribe of North Carolina. Former civics teacher, Lumbee Tribal Council member, and leader at the U.S. Department of Agriculture and N.C. Department of Commerce, according to his campaign site.
cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace or when his family settled in North Carolina; the lifelong-resident claim comes from his own campaign site. We found no statements or actions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no bills he has sponsored, no endorsements, and no documented controversies or foreign ties. His Tribal Council, USDA and Commerce roles are described only on his campaign site, with no independent confirmation of dates or titles.

local.label: Roots 90: His campaign site describes him as a lifelong Robeson County resident and a UNC Pembroke graduate, but no page gives his birthplace.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has served in the N.C. House since October 2025. Chairman of the Lumbee Tribe and a former Lumbee Tribal Council member. Previously a civics teacher and held leadership roles at the USDA and N.C. Department of Commerce. Holds a Master of Public Administration from UNC-Chapel Hill.
qual.why: Scored in the upper-middle range for a legislator with about a year in the House, tribal legislative and executive experience, state and federal agency work, and public administration training. The House service is short and the tribal and agency roles are described only on his campaign site and Ballotpedia, so the score stops short of the top band.

cands.name: Eshonda Hooper
cands.bio: Eshonda Hooper is a Democrat who ran for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 47 in 2024 and 2026. She lost both general elections to the Republican incumbent. She has not held elected office, and the page I had does not describe her work history.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed or recommended in 2026 by Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy, a Sway voting group run by Tevin (Momala) Davis.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Eshonda Hooper was born or raised, or when she came to North Carolina. We found no information on her occupation, education or work history. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026, and we found no campaign website or platform statements on any issue. We found no record of actions she has taken on any policy topic, no stated positions on data centers or development, and no news coverage of her.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: No occupation or work history was available. Her only documented activity is two unsuccessful campaigns for NC House District 47, in 2024 and 2026.
qual.why: Running for office without winning does not count as experience, and no career information was found, so no score is given.
